origin: skeleton origin = bottom-centre of the Viking layout box (root bone carries scale 0.4898 so 1 unit = 1 landscape px)

Landscape.note: screen px, y down: put the skeleton origin at (x, y), skeleton scale = scale (y flipped per runtime)

Portrait.note: screen px, y down: put the skeleton origin at (x, y), skeleton scale = scale (y flipped per runtime)

mix.note: Use AnimationStateData default mix 0.25 s; every clip blends back to idle_breathe.

state_machine.IDLE: loop idle_breathe; after each loop pick weighted: idle_breathe 60, idle_bored 20, idle_look_reels 20
state_machine.SPIN_PRESS: play spin_start (track 0, no loop) then queue idle_look_reels (loop) until reels stop
state_machine.SCATTER_ANTICIPATION: set anticipation (loop) when the 2nd Scatter lands; leave on reels stop
state_machine.RESULT: WIN_BIG -> win_big ; WIN_SMALL -> win_small ; LOSE -> lose_grumble with p=0.33 else idle ; then queue idle_breathe
state_machine.FREE_SPINS_TRIGGER: scatter_trigger, then queue free_spins_cheer (loop) for the whole round; spin_start still plays on each FS spin, then back to free_spins_cheer
state_machine.rule: event clips always play through (never cut by the idle picker); a new game event may interrupt with the mix time

idle_breathe.when: Default idle. Rotate with idle_bored / idle_look_reels.

idle_bored.when: Idle variant after ~8 s with no spin: sigh, looks around, drums fingers on the sill.

idle_look_reels.when: While the reels are spinning (between spin_start and reels_stop) and as a rare idle.

spin_start.when: Every spin press: yells the order into the intercom.

anticipation.when: When 2 Scatters have landed and the remaining reels are still spinning (loop until reels stop).

win_small.when: Win below big-win threshold (e.g. < 10x bet): smug nod.

win_big.when: Big/mega win (>= 10x bet): roar, handset raised like a fist, slams the sill, mead spray.

scatter_trigger.when: 3+ Scatters trigger free spins: shock, then excitement. Then queue free_spins_cheer.

free_spins_cheer.when: Loop for the whole free-spins round (between spins too).

lose_grumble.when: On some losing spins (suggest 1 in 3, never twice in a row): eye roll and mutter.

events.slam: fist slams sill (thud + small screen shake)
